# RubyT 2.0

RubyT 2.0 is a lightweight and customizable AI-focused Android browser that brings a wide range of AI tools and online services together in one simple application.

## Overview

The app organizes AI services into convenient categories such as Chat, Images, Programming, Video, Audio, Search, Writing, and Social.

RubyT provides quick access to popular AI platforms and tools, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Copilot, Grok, Perplexity, and many others.

The app is designed to make accessing AI services easier, especially on devices where dedicated AI applications may not be available or practical.

RubyT also allows users to add their own websites and create custom sections. These custom websites and sections are private to the user.

Additional security and privacy systems are planned for future versions to help protect user data and privacy.

## Key Features

- Multiple AI categories in one application
- Quick access to popular AI services
- Custom websites and sections
- Private user customization
- Lightweight design
- Data-saving features
- Simple and organized interface
- Convenient access to AI tools from one place
- Privacy and data protection features

## Customization

RubyT allows users to add their own websites and create custom sections.

These custom websites and sections are private to the user.

## Known Technical Issue

There is currently a technical issue with TikTok in the Social section. TikTok may open in the Chrome browser instead of inside RubyT.

This issue is being addressed and is planned to be improved in future releases.

## Experimental Status

RubyT is currently in its experimental phase.

The application may contain technical errors and issues. These issues are planned to be fixed and improved in future versions.

## Future Plans

Future versions are planned to introduce additional improvements, features, security enhancements, and performance improvements.
